scenarios.request: Assign a contributor to create a local change in one repository from an exact base and hand off the commit.
expected_owner_actions: Agent governance owns the assignment, budget, lease, handoff, and release.
Repository governance owns branch, worktree, commit, and exact base/head evidence.
scenarios.stop: Stop at the local handoff commit; push and cleanup require separate authority.

scenarios.request: Select eligible candidates for a release window spanning dependent api and web repositories, decide which stable project branches require remote synchronization after the gate, assign execution, integrate locally, and record the gate.
expected_owner_actions: Project governance owns candidate and window selection, the gate decision, and remote-sync branch selection and timing.
Workspace governance owns exact repository tuples and dependency order.
Repository governance owns per-repository integration and execution of the exact approved remote-sync refspecs.
Agent governance owns assignments, independence, budgets, and released leases.
scenarios.stop: Stop when the exact local integration heads, gate decision, and RemoteSyncPlan are recorded unless separate push authority is present; deployment is not implied.

scenarios.request: An assigned coordinator wants to update the canonical external WorkItem, but its expected revision is stale.
expected_owner_actions: Agent governance reports the blocked assignment and preserves its budget and lease state.
Project governance re-reads through TaskSource and owns the conflict decision.
scenarios.stop: Stop without an external write until a new expected revision and authority are supplied.

scenarios.request: After a completed handoff, release ownership and consider deleting the local branch and worktree.
expected_owner_actions: Agent governance releases the ownership lease and reports clean or dirty state.
Repository governance resolves exact cleanup targets and checks recovery, integration, and authority.
scenarios.stop: Stop at a cleanup candidate unless exact targets, clean/recovery evidence, and explicit cleanup authority are present.
